text:
Maya (marketing): Hi @eng-runtime — quick production ask. We need a small, reproducible rerun pack for the launch post. Target model: redwood-7b-q8-v2.

Maya (marketing): Deliverables: sanitized CSVs (latency per request), warmup trace, 1-paragraph methodology note, and one suggested 1-line caption calling out p95 and quantized cost delta.

Kai (marketing-ops): cohorts = interactive (250 small prompts), embed-batch (1000 short texts), long-context (50 x 2048). Include one example prompt per cohort, anonymized.

Olivia (eng-runtime): We can run on staging-dpool. Clarify: coldstart = first request after 30s idle? Pin kernels?

Maya (marketing): yes to 30s idle coldstart. Pin kernels if it stabilizes results; just document everything.

Sandeep (runtime): plan to run: ./bench-runner --model redwood-7b-q8-v2 --quant q8 --batch 1,4 --seq 32,512,2048 --warmup 100 --requests 250 --output csv --trace warmup.json. Capture p50/p95/p99 and GPU mem. ETA ~6h.

bench-bot: created job RERUN-7831 on staging-dpool-2, est runtime 6h, artifacts -> /artifacts/reruns/4800001111/.

Maya (marketing): timeline: need CSV + short notes by EOD Thursday so comms can draft the launch post. If any PII/sanitization blockers ping Kai. :pray:

Olivia (eng-runtime): will upload compressed CSVs + README with exact commands and env vars. We'll post here when done.

Sandeep (runtime): copied, will flag if rerun needed or if tail jitter looks weird.

Maya (marketing): thanks all — a 2-sentence suggested caption would be perfect (we'll edit copy).
